children.description:
I found a homeless shelter in Seattle called "Downtown Emergency Service Center - DESC Seattle". The address is 515 3rd Ave S, Seattle, WA 98104. You can contact them at (206) 464-1570 or send an email to info@desc.org. They have a website at http://www.desc.org/ where you can find more information. They also have social media accounts on Twitter, Facebook, and Instagram.

To get involved as a volunteer, you can visit the shelter daily between 8am and 4:45pm. They have different services for men and women. For men, they serve those who are 60+ or any adult vulnerable due to mental illness, developmental disabilities, chemical dependency, and/or medical condition. For women, you can visit the shelter registration desk at 8am, and assignments are made at 10am. Additional slots are assigned as space allows. DESC is a non-profit organization dedicated to helping marginalized individuals find homes.

Is there anything else I can assist you with?
